style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">To supplement the presentation of its financial results prepared in accordance with generally EOG believes excluding these impairments from total impairment costs is appropriate and provides useful information to investors, as such impairments were caused by factors outside of EOG&#8217;s control (versus, for example, impairments that are due to EOG&#8217;s proved oil and gas properties not being as productive as it originally estimated).
